rules.title: HTTPS transport
evidenceRequirements: Final validated Target URL after allowed redirects
rules.detectorLogic: Fail when the final validated Target URL uses the http scheme instead of https.
rules.severityLogic: Critical when the final validated Target is delivered over HTTP.
rules.confidenceLogic: Deterministic scheme observation from the final GuardAI fetch URL; does not assess TLS configuration quality beyond HTTPS use.
rules.messageTemplate: The analyzed Target finished on unencrypted HTTP after allowed redirects.
rules.remediation: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS and ensure the Target is served exclusively over correctly configured HTTPS.
rules.changelog: v1: initial deterministic HTTPS transport rule.

rules.title: Content-Security-Policy presence
rules.detectorLogic: Fail when the final observed response does not contain a Content-Security-Policy header.
rules.severityLogic: Critical for the current GuardAI security baseline when CSP is absent; policy quality is not assessed by this rule.
rules.confidenceLogic: High confidence for header presence/absence on the observed response only; does not prove CSP coverage across all application routes.
rules.messageTemplate: No Content-Security-Policy header was observed on the analyzed response.
rules.remediation: Define a suitable Content-Security-Policy and test it safely, commonly beginning with Report-Only before enforcement.

rules.title: Strict-Transport-Security presence
rules.detectorLogic: Applicable only when the final Target uses HTTPS; fail when Strict-Transport-Security is absent from the observed response.
rules.severityLogic: Warning when HSTS is absent on an observed HTTPS response.
rules.confidenceLogic: High confidence for the observed response header only; does not infer preload readiness or subdomain policy correctness.
rules.messageTemplate: No Strict-Transport-Security header was observed on the analyzed HTTPS response.
rules.remediation: Enable HSTS only after HTTPS is complete and stable for the intended hosts, using a policy appropriate to the deployment.
rules.changelog: v1: initial HTTPS-only HSTS presence rule.

rules.title: Frame embedding protection
rules.detectorLogic: Pass when X-Frame-Options is present or CSP contains an observable frame-ancestors directive; otherwise fail.
rules.severityLogic: Warning when neither supported frame-protection mechanism is observed.
rules.confidenceLogic: High confidence for presence of the two inspected mechanisms on the observed response; policy semantics are not fully evaluated.
rules.messageTemplate: No unambiguous frame-embedding protection was observed on the analyzed response.
rules.remediation: Prefer a deliberate CSP frame-ancestors policy and verify the embedding origins the application actually requires.
rules.changelog: v1: initial X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors presence rule.

rules.title: X-Content-Type-Options nosniff
rules.detectorLogic: Pass only when X-Content-Type-Options normalizes to the value nosniff on the observed response.
rules.severityLogic: Warning when the nosniff directive is not observed.
rules.confidenceLogic: Deterministic header-value observation for the analyzed response only.
rules.messageTemplate: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff was not observed on the analyzed response.
rules.remediation: Set X-Content-Type-Options to nosniff unless a documented technical exception requires different behavior.

rules.title: Secure attribute on HTTPS cookies
evidenceRequirements: Set-Cookie headers from the observed response
rules.detectorLogic: Applicable when the observed HTTPS response sets at least one cookie; fail when one or more observed Set-Cookie values lack the Secure attribute.
rules.severityLogic: Warning when any cookie set by the observed HTTPS response lacks Secure.
rules.confidenceLogic: High confidence for the cookies set in the observed response; does not prove attributes for cookies created on other routes or client-side code.
rules.messageTemplate: One or more cookies set by the analyzed HTTPS response were observed without the Secure attribute.
rules.remediation: Review affected cookies and apply Secure to cookies that must only travel over HTTPS.

rules.title: Mixed HTTP content on HTTPS document
evidenceRequirements: Bounded HTML body of the observed response
rules.detectorLogic: For an HTTPS document, inspect bounded supported resource attributes and fail when absolute HTTP resource URLs are observed.
rules.severityLogic: Critical when at least one observed mixed-content resource is classified as active by this detector; otherwise warning when only passive supported resources are observed.
rules.confidenceLogic: Deterministic for supported HTML attributes in the bounded observed document; runtime-generated or unsupported resource references may remain unassessed.
rules.messageTemplate: Absolute HTTP resources were observed in the analyzed HTTPS document.
rules.remediation: Load the affected resources over HTTPS or remove the insecure embedding, then run a new scan.
rules.changelog: v1: initial bounded mixed-content observation rule.
